image_description: A slice of layered chocolate cake served on a white plate, accompanied by two scoops of vanilla ice cream. The cake features dark chocolate sponge layers and a lighter filling, topped with a dollop of whipped cream and a thin, upright chocolate garnish. Dark chocolate sauce is drizzled over the side of the cake and pools slightly on the plate. A small red berry garnish sits in the foreground.
